changelog.name: Modules Manager 2.1.0
changelog.body:
Modules Manager 2.1.0

- New package id: io.github.rushiranpise.modulesmanager
- Browse, search, install and update Xposed/LSPosed modules
- Floating navigation, Library, download controls, diagnostics and source alternatives

changelog.name: Modules Manager 2.3.0
changelog.body:
## Features

- **Save APKs without installing:** on Android 10 and newer, save a release APK to `Download/ModulesManager` from the module page. The transfer runs in the foreground service, shows progress in the app and notification, and can be cancelled from either place.
- **API level chips:** module cards and detail pages show the target libxposed API level. Older modules without a target API are marked **Legacy**.
- **Notification permission timing:** the permission prompt now appears when the first download, save or batch starts instead of at launch. Settings also has a Notifications entry.

## Fixes

- **Tablet navigation:** switching rail tabs from a module or developer page returns to the selected tab root instead of reopening the old detail page.
- **Background transfers:** batch downloads and manual APK saves keep running in the foreground service when the app is backgrounded.
- **Update batches:** delegated installs no longer hold up the rest of a batch, duplicate update starts are blocked, and the manager's own update is installed last.
- **Root checks:** root availability checks stop after 15 seconds instead of potentially hanging.
- **Cold start:** opening the app no longer shows a stale list-update message for cached data.


## Download

- `ModulesManager-15-2.3.0-release.apk`: signed release build

changelog.name: Modules Manager 2.2.4
changelog.body:
## Fixes

- **Same-code releases:** installed updates are found when a release keeps its version code but has a newer publish time, as xviphook does.
- **Split libxposed modules:** modules whose libxposed marker is in a split APK or `native_init.list` are detected after install.
- **Update progress:** update-all progress now appears in the bottom banner used by downloads and messages, with the current module, done count, cancel and dismiss actions. The card at the top is gone.


## Download

- `ModulesManager-14-2.2.4-release.apk`: signed release build

changelog.name: Modules Manager 2.2.3
changelog.body:
## Highlights

- **Uninstall works again:** modules are removed through the selected installer. Shizuku and root uninstall silently; system and session open the system uninstaller, with a fallback if the preferred one is unavailable.
- **Chinese ROMs:** Modules Manager asks once for the installed-apps permission on HyperOS, ColorOS and similar ROMs, so module detection works there.
- **Release notes:** rendered as formatted Markdown, translated with the same language and auto-translate settings as descriptions and READMEs, and separated by clean dividers.
- **Module pages:** fork count beside stars, an orange date pill, an accent author pill with the person icon, and the version pill in the metadata row. The Information tab is gone.
- **Recent and starred cards:** compact horizontal cards with equal height.
- **Sort by sources:** the Modules list can sort by how many repositories the index lists for a package.

## Fixes

- Fixed the launch crash on phones with large installed-package lists by reading package metadata one app at a time.
- Fixed a scan crash when a package disappears between the list and its metadata lookup.
- Debug modules now download the debug APK instead of the release APK with a different package name.
- Snackbars and message banners follow the app theme and match the download banner instead of appearing white.
- Tablets keep the navigation rail; phones keep the phone navigation in landscape.


## Download

- `ModulesManager-13-2.2.3-release.apk`: signed release build

changelog.name: Modules Manager 2.2.2
changelog.body:
## Highlights

- **Formatted release notes:** the Releases tab now renders headings, bullet lists, bold and italic text, inline code, code blocks and blockquotes instead of showing raw Markdown syntax.
- The collapsed preview hides the Markdown markers, and **Read more** opens the formatted version.


## Download

- `ModulesManager-12-2.2.2-release.apk`: signed release build

changelog.name: Modules Manager 2.2.1
changelog.body:
## Fixes

- Fix a launch crash on phones with many installed apps. Package metadata is now read one app at a time instead of in a single oversized request.


## Download

- `ModulesManager-11-2.2.1-release.apk`: signed release build

changelog.name: Modules Manager 2.2.0
changelog.body:
## Highlights

- **Developer pages:** tap **by <author>** on a module page or **More by <author>** in a card menu to see every module from that GitHub developer.
- **Cleaner cards:** outlined package pill, gold star count, gray fork count and a red favourite heart. Long descriptions expand with **Read more**.
- **More card actions:** copy the package name, open the repository's releases list or open the developer page from the three-dot menu.
- **Module page refresh:** Material 3 segmented tabs, the author below the release date, and an **Uninstall** action for installed modules.
- **AMOLED:** fully black cards, navigation pill and download banner with a hairline outline.
- **Update time:** the Modules list reports when the index was last updated on launch and after a refresh.

## Fixes

- "Open releases" opens the repository's releases list instead of a single tag.
- Empty Diagnostics storage shows `0 B` instead of "unknown size".
- The selected module tab no longer draws a checkmark.
- The Latest version label is removed from the module header.


## Download

- `ModulesManager-10-2.2.0-release.apk`: signed release build

readme:
# Modules Manager 📦

An Android app for finding, installing and updating Xposed/Lsposed modules.

- Package: `io.github.rushiranpise.modulesmanager`
- Android 8.1 (API 26) and newer
- Versions up to 2.0.0 used `com.rushi.modulesmanager` and update separately.
- ⬇️ [Latest release](https://github.com/rushiranpise/lsposed-modules-manager/releases)

## What's new in 2.0

- A floating navigation pill with a gradient scrim, dynamic color, and a rail on tablets.
- A Library tab for favourites, recently viewed modules, and skipped or ignored updates.
- Per-update progress and cancel, pause and resume, retry after a dropped network, and 1 to 5 concurrent downloads.
- A Diagnostics page with device and build details, cache sizes, copy and share, and cleanup actions.
- The source picker now lists every repository the daily index holds for a package.
- A new app icon.

## Features

- Browse over 2,000 module repositories from the daily [xposed-modules index](https://github.com/rushiranpise/xposed-modules).
- Search, sort by name, last update, stars or recently added, and filter by updates, installed or not installed.
- See the installed version next to an available update. Each update row shows its own download percentage and can be cancelled without stopping the rest of the batch.
- Pause and resume a module download, or let it retry after a dropped connection and continue from the bytes already on disk. Settings can limit the app to 1 to 5 concurrent downloads.
- Open a module to read its README, its full GitHub release history and target apps.
- The Releases tab lists every published release, stable and pre-release, with their APKs.
- Translate module descriptions and READMEs, manually or automatically.
- Install with the system installer, a PackageInstaller session, Shizuku, or root for silent installs. Installs handed to an external installer are remembered and confirmed on the next scan.
- When a release ships several equally suitable APKs, a chooser reads the ABI, vendor OS, Android version and libxposed API level, and remembers the choice for later releases.
- Override the source repository of a module when the index points at a fork. The picker lists the alternate repositories from the index and marks the current one.
- Cards show a small sources badge when the index lists more than one repository for the package.
- Long press an installed module to uninstall it.
- The Installed tab lists every installed module, including ones missing from the index. Its filters are All, Updates, Skipped and Untracked.
- Star modules to keep them in the Library, together with recently viewed modules and skipped or ignored updates.
- Floating refresh, sort and scroll-to-top actions, a navigation rail on wide windows, and package events that keep the installed list current.
- Light, dark and system themes, Material You colors, AMOLED black and GitHub-style identicons.
- Diagnostics in Settings shows the build commit, device, module counts and cache sizes, with copy, share and clear actions.

The app also declares itself as a self-scoped Xposed module. It hooks nothing; the declaration lets LSPosed Manager install and update the app. Its scope list is intentionally the app itself, so LSPosed Manager shows no other targets.

## Translation

Translation goes through Google's public translate endpoint, so no API key or account is needed. The text leaves the device, and the endpoint needs a working network connection.

- **Translate automatically** in Settings translates module descriptions when the list loads and the README when a module is opened.
- **Language** picks the target language, or keeps the device language.
- Requests are batched, Google hosts are tried in turn if one fails, and translations are cached per language.
- README translation rewrites only prose. Links, images, code blocks and inline code keep their exact syntax.
- Rows whose description is already in the target language hide the translate icon.

## Build

Requires JDK 21 and Android SDK 37.

```bash
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest
```

Signed release APKs are built by the [release workflow](.github/workflows/release.yml) when a `v*` tag is pushed. One APK covers every CPU architecture.

## Data

The app reads the daily index from:

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rushiranpise/xposed-modules/main/data/repos.json`

Each entry provides the package, summary, target scope and latest APK release. Installed modules are checked against GitHub releases when the app starts, then at most once every six hours, so releases published after the daily snapshot still appear. The index has no README and keeps only the newest release per channel, so opening a module fetches its README from raw.githubusercontent.com and its release history from the GitHub API. Unauthenticated GitHub API rate limits can delay the history until the quota resets.

The Installed tab counts every installed module. The Installed filter on the Modules screen only counts modules that are in the index. When the GitHub API rate limit is reached, manually linked repositories and live update checks fall back to the public releases Atom feed and its expanded asset list.

## License

GPL-3.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
readmeZh:
# 模块管理器📦

一款用于查找、安装和更新 Xposed/Lspond 模块的 Android 应用程序。

- 包：`io.github.rushiranpise.modulesmanager`
- Android 8.1 (API 26) 及更高版本
- 2.0.0 之前的版本使用 `com.rushi.modulesmanager` 并单独更新。
- ⬇️ [最新版本](https://github.com/rushiranpise/lsfused-modules-manager/releases)

## 2.0 中的新增内容

- 浮动导航药丸，具有渐变稀松布、动态色彩和平板电脑导轨。
- 一个“库”选项卡，用于收藏、最近查看的模块以及跳过或忽略的更新。
- 每次更新进度和取消、暂停和恢复、网络断开后重试以及 1 到 5 个并发下载。
- 诊断页面，其中包含设备和构建详细信息、缓存大小、复制和共享以及清理操作。
- 源选择器现在列出了每日索引为包保留的每个存储库。
- 新的应用程序图标。

## 特点

- 从每日 [xposed-modules 索引](https://github.com/rushiranpise/xposed-modules) 浏览 2,000 多个模块存储库。
- 搜索、按名称、上次更新、加星标或最近添加排序，并按更新、已安装或未安装进行过滤。
- 查看可用更新旁边的已安装版本。每个更新行都会显示自己的下载百分比，并且可以在不停止批次其余部分的情况下取消。
- 暂停和恢复模块下载，或者在连接断开后重试并从磁盘上已有的字节继续。设置可以将应用程序的并发下载限制为 1 到 5 个。
- 打开模块以阅读其自述文件、完整的 GitHub 发布历史记录和目标应用程序。
-“发布”选项卡列出了每个已发布的版本（稳定版和预发布版）及其 APK。
- 手动或自动翻译模块描述和自述文件。
- 使用系统安装程序、PackageInstaller 会话、Shizuku 或 root 进行静默安装。交给外部安装程序的安装会被记住并在下次扫描时得到确认。
- 当一个版本发布多个同样合适的 APK 时，选择器会读取 ABI、供应商操作系统、Android 版本和 libxposed API 级别，并记住后续版本的选择。
- 当索引指向分叉时覆盖模块的源存储库。选择器列出索引中的备用存储库并标记当前存储库。
- 当索引列出多个包的存储库时，卡片会显示一个小的源徽章。
- 长按已安装的模块即可将其卸载。
-“已安装”选项卡列出了每个已安装的模块，包括索引中缺少的模块。其过滤器包括“全部”、“更新”、“跳过”和“未跟踪”。
- 给模块加星标，将其与最近查看的模块以及跳过或忽略的更新一起保留在库中。
- 浮动刷新、排序和滚动到顶部操作、宽窗口上的导航栏以及使已安装列表保持最新状态的包事件。
- 浅色、深色和系统主题、Material You 颜色、AMOLED 黑色和 GitHub 风格的标识。
- 设置中的诊断显示构建提交、设备、模块计数和缓存大小，以及复制、共享和清除操作。

该应用程序还声明自己是一个自我范围的 Xposed 模块。它什么也钩不住；该声明允许 LSPod Manager 安装和更新应用程序。其范围列表有意为应用程序本身，因此 LSPod Manager 不显示其他目标。

## 翻译

翻译通过 Google 的公共翻译端点进行，因此不需要 API 密钥或帐户。文本离开设备，端点需要有效的网络连接。

- 设置中的 **自动翻译** 在加载列表时翻译模块描述，在打开模块时翻译自述文件。
- **语言** 选择目标语言，或保留设备语言。
- 请求被分批处理，如果失败，Google 主机会依次尝试，并且翻译会按语言缓存。
- 自述文件翻译仅重写散文。链接、图像、代码块和内联代码保持其准确的语法。
- 描述已采用目标语言的行隐藏翻译图标。

## 构建

需要 JDK 21 和机器人 SDK 37。

````bash
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest
````

当推送 `v*` 标签时，签名的发布 APK 是由 [发布工作流程](.github/workflows/release.yml) 构建的。一个 APK 涵盖所有 CPU 架构。

## 数据

该应用程序从以下位置读取每日索引：

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rushiranpise/xposed-modules/main/data/repos.json`

每个条目都提供包、摘要、目标范围和最新 APK 版本。应用程序启动时，将根据 GitHub 版本检查已安装的模块，然后最多每六个小时检查一次，因此每日快照之后发布的版本仍然会出现。该索引没有 README，并且仅保留每个通道的最新版本，因此打开模块会从 raw.githubusercontent.com 获取其 README，并从 GitHub API 获取其发布历史记录。未经身份验证的 GitHub API 速率限制可能会延迟历史记录，直到配额重置。

“已安装”选项卡对每个已安装的模块进行计数。模块屏幕上的已安装过滤器仅计算索引中的模块。当达到 GitHub API 速率限制时，手动链接的存储库和实时更新检查将回退到公共版本 Atom 源及其扩展资产列表。

## 许可证

GPL-3.0。请参阅[许可证]（许可证）。
